ev.q: Among 29,175 nucleic acid amplification tests (NAATs) with SGTF or SGTP results available
the relative VE of a bivalent booster dose given 2–3 months earlier compared with no bivalent booster in persons aged 18–49 years was 52%
Relative VE of a bivalent booster dose was calculated by comparing odds of receipt of a bivalent booster dose
Overall (≥2 weeks since bivalent booster dose)
Across age groups, VE was generally similar against BA.5-related infections and XBB/XBB.1.5-related infections.
Odds ratios (ORs) were estimated using multivariable logistic regression
control-patients were those who received a negative NAAT result

methods_quotes.q: Odds ratios (ORs) were estimated using multivariable logistic regression
Relative VE of a bivalent booster dose was calculated by comparing odds of receipt of a bivalent booster dose with those of no bivalent booster
VE was calculated separately based on SGTF/SGTP status as (1 − OR) x 100
